title: One line of data/seed/<poolId>/personas.jsonl
description: Public profile fields only. Hidden traits (outgoingness, flakiness, true interests) live in data/sim_private and are never in this file.

avatar.description: Path relative to the pool folder, e.g. 'avatars/u_0042.png'. Fictional, generated or licensed images only; never photos of real people unless licensed and listed in avatars/PROVENANCE.md.

availability.description: Coarse fallback availability; busy blocks live in connectors.jsonl.

cloneProfileId.description: Only for u_maya: the facebook-clone seed person ID ('maya').

connectedProviders.description: Providers this synthetic persona has connected; the backend activates their connector records at load. Empty for u_maya (she connects live in the demo).
